exposure: Hysteroscopic repair surgery for cesarean scar defect (CSD)
cohort: The study included 82 patients with cesarean scar defect (CSD) undergoing frozen embryo transfer (FET), divided into those undergoing CSD repair and those undergoing hysteroscopic treatment for other uterine lesions.
finding: Hysteroscopic treatment of CSD in symptomatic patients undergoing FET did not show significant differences in clinical pregnancy rates, miscarriage, live birth, preterm birth, or pregnancy complications compared to patients undergoing hysteroscopic treatment for other uterine lesions.
